findings_detail.PAYLOAD_SCHEMA_MISMATCH_MCP: user-OfersClaw5 prepare-trade takes {account:'real', direction:'buy'|'sellShort', instrumentId, units|amount, leverage, stopLossRate, takeProfitRate, orderType}. There is no isBuy, so the agent must translate isBuy:true to direction, which reintroduces the risk 'copy verbatim' was meant to remove. prepare-close takes {account:'real', positionId(int), unitsToDeduct|null}, so instrumentId and isBuy are extra fields. execute_pass never sees the prepare-trade/prepare-close confirmation, so it cannot confirm that what the token will place equals the pinned payload.
findings_detail.QA_WINDOW_60S_DEADLOCK: pack_sha256 includes quote_ts and the quote must be <=60s old at GO. Order-QA must therefore review and write its verdict within the same 60 seconds, which is not realistic. This pushes the flow toward self-written verdicts.
findings_detail.RSI_PATH_EFFECTIVELY_DISABLED: Production propose has no way to supply a cited p. Every RSI pack's preliminary verdict is COST_GATE_SKIP, so auto_place_eligible=False, so execute_pass returns NOT_AUTO_PLACE_ELIGIBLE even if --p-hit is given. This is conservative and acceptable. Only the rebalance path can GO today.

required_corrections: A. VERDICT_FORGEABLE: execute_pass must only accept verdicts from a fixed QA directory (/workspace/classic_rsi/audit/qa/), named qa-verdict-{run|order}-<pack_sha256[:16]>.json, with checker=='QA Bot'. The order-QA verdict must embed recomputed_cost_gate {spread, fees, tax_est, total_cost, expected_gain, ratio} and execute_pass must match its own block within +/-0.01. Hard-code --audit-dir/--book in production (test override only via an env var that execute_pass logs). Residual risk: on a shared box any agent can still write files, so Ofer must explicitly accept this or keep manual authorization.

B. P_SOURCE_UNVALIDATED: replace the free-text p_source with a registry file (classic_rsi/evidence/p_registry.json, sha-pinned in code) holding {id, wins, n, out_of_sample:true, period}. p_used = Wilson lower 95% bound computed from wins/n, never the typed p. Require n>=100.

C. EDGE_EVIDENCE_UNVALIDATED: the edge must reference an evidence registry entry (sha-pinned) with n>=30 and out-of-sample results. Cap expected_return_pct at registry hit-rate x average move, or at most 2x daily ATR% x sqrt(horizon). Reject horizon_days<5 for rebalance. Recompute er_new/er_held from the score data (classic-rebalance RS table) instead of accepting typed values.

D. INDEPENDENT_MARK_OPTIONAL: make --mark (and leg 'independent_mark') mandatory at the final stage, from a second source (eToro live rates read vs prepare quote, or Yahoo), with |ask-mark|/mark <= 0.1%.

E. LOCK_BYPASS: lock key = sha256(canonical(run_id, symbol.upper().strip(), instrumentId)) for RSI. For rebalance: (kind, sorted legs' instrumentId+side, ET trading date). Keep the lock under a fixed path independent of --audit-dir. Normalize/validate pack_id with a regex (^classic-rsi-auto-\d{8}-\d{6}-[0-9a-f]{8}#[A-Z.]+$ / ^classic-rebalance-\d{8}-[a-z0-9-]+$).

F. REBALANCE_DUPLICATE_AND_STALE_BOOK: for every buy leg, block if a GO lock exists for the same instrumentId+side in the same ET trading day, or a position on that instrumentId was opened <24h ago. Require a book asOf <=60s (same read as the cash) for caps and duplicate checks.

G. RISK_EXIT_UNVERIFIED: verify each reason from data. hard_cap_breach: recompute name/sleeve % from the book > hard cap. cash_below_floor: live cash < 2500. stop_hit: bid <= the position's stopLossRate or trailing level from the book. trigger_3/4: require the daily-close/50DMA/200DMA/RS evidence block with its source and recompute. Otherwise NO-GO.

H. REALIZED_PNL_UNVERIFIED: recompute realized = (bid - openRate) x units (or (value - invested) x units/held_units) from the book position. Use max(supplied, recomputed) for tax; mismatch > $1 gives NO-GO.

I. PAYLOAD_SCHEMA_MISMATCH_MCP: emit MCP-native payloads. Buy: {account:'real', direction:'buy', instrumentId, units, leverage:1, orderType:'mkt', stopLossRate, takeProfitRate}. Close: {account:'real', positionId:int, unitsToDeduct:number|null}. Add an input --prepare-response (the JSON confirmation from prepare-trade/prepare-close) and assert it echoes instrumentId, direction 'buy', leverage 1, units (+/-1e-6), SL/TP and the quote used. Include it in pack_sha256.

J. SL_NOT_ATR_BOUNDED: for rebalance buys, require daily_atr and enforce ask - 3.5xATRd <= SL <= ask - 1.0xATRd (or the ETF 8% / stock 10-12% trailing rule). The SL must also be <= the prepare-trade max stop bounds.

K. QA_WINDOW_60S_DEADLOCK: bind order-QA to {pack, units, payload, cost_gate inputs except the live quote, qa_ask}. At GO, require a fresh quote <=60s with |ask - qa_ask|/qa_ask <= 0.1%, and recompute the cost gate (must still PASS).
L. Tests: add a test for every repro in adversarial_repros.

common.checked_at: ISO-8601 WITH offset, e.g. '2026-10-12T17:58:00+03:00' or '2026-10-12T14:58:00Z'. Naive values and suffixes like '17:58 IDT' are rejected. Age <= 3600s (run-QA) / <= 900s (order-QA) at execute time. A value more than 60s in the future is rejected.
common.extra_fields: ignored by code (keep codes, evidence, recomputed numbers per the skill)

run_qa_rsi.match: run_id/propose_run_id must equal one of: auto run_id from pack_id, envelope run_id, propose_run_id, pack.run_id

order_qa_rsi.match: symbol upper == pack symbol (e.g. 'T'); pack_sha256 == the 64-hex pack_sha256 execute_pass prints for the IDENTICAL inputs (same pack, final units, bid, ask, quote_ts string, payload); the file path must differ from the run-QA file. pack_id is NOT checked on the RSI path.

order_qa_rebalance.match: pack_id exact string equality with pack.pack_id; pack_sha256 == sha256(canonical {pack_id, pack, order_payloads}). run_id/symbol are not checked.
